Name: PFM Rice Vinegar
Author: LuckyPicks
Description:
Makes Unmilled Rice juice turn into vinegar in keg. A bottle of unmilled rice juice can make 2-5 bottles of vinegar. So that you don't have to go to the Pierre store to buy vinegar.

[b][size=5]FAQ[/size][/b]
Decompression failed: Change the file suffix .7z to .zip to extract normally

Time required: The process from juice to vinegar takes 10.5 hours in "Stardew Valley".

About automate mod: [color=#f4f4f4]The mod relies on PFM mod, which is not supported by "Automate" mod. But you can use "PFMAutomate" mod to execute this production rule. (BTW , "Automate" and "PFMAutomate" are compatible with each other ).[/color]
